Title: Add HTTPS probes to standard load balancers from the Azure portal

Body.Content: The Azure portal now has built-in support to add HTTPS probes to standard load balancers. You can configure these probes to get health status from specific paths and ports, the interval between attempts, and the unhealthy threshold. For more information, see the Load balancer health probes documentation.
